name: Sihon
summary: A king of the Amorites who ruled from Heshbon. When he refused to let Israel pass through his land and attacked them, Israel defeated him and took his land.

key_moments.title: No Way Through
key_moments.description: Israel asked to pass along the king's highway, but Sihon refused and came out to fight them at Jahaz. Israel defeated him and took his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, including his city Heshbon.

key_moments.title: His Kingdom Given Away
key_moments.description: Moses gave the kingdom of Sihon, along with that of Og, to the tribes of Gad and Reuben and half the tribe of Manasseh.

key_moments.title: Feared in Jericho
key_moments.description: Rahab told the spies that her people had heard how Israel destroyed Sihon and Og, the two Amorite kings beyond the Jordan. Their hearts had melted with fear.
